questions.markdown: What are varargs? Illustrate varargs and the ambiguity associated with them with an example program.

Write two different Java programs to illustrate the following:

i) Using labelled break as a Form of goto.

ii) Labelled break inside nested loops.

Create a Date class with three integer instance variables named day, month, year. It has a constructor with three parameters for initializing the instance variables, and it has one method named daysSinceJan1( ). Override toString() method for Date class to be used to display date in the format dd/mm/yyyy. It computes and returns the number of days since January 1 of the same year, including January 1 and the day in the Date object. For example, if day is a Date object with day = 1, month = 3, and year = 2000, then the call date.daysSinceJan1( ) should return 61 since there are 61 days between the dates of January 1, 2000, and March 1, 2000, including January 1 and March 1. Include a DateDemo class that tests the Date class by creating an array of Date class of size n. Don't forget leap years.

Create a generic class with one type parameter, T. Provide an appropriate constructor that initialises the data member of this class that holds a reference to an array of type T. Also, implement the following methods:

1) getDevice(int id) that returns a Device object whose id is passed in method argument. If no record is found, it displays an appropriate message and returns the first device.
2) sort() that sorts the records of Device based on watt where, class Device contains two data members watt and id. Create two classes Fan and Kettle that are derived from Device. sweep (short) and brand (String) are data members of Fan. Also, Kettle contains two data members capacity (double) and name (String). Provide a method display() in both the classes to print the details on the console output. Write a driver class that
i) creates an array of Fan and Kettle devices.
ii) Instantiate the generic class on Fan and Kettle devices and display them.
iii) Invoke the getDevie(int id) method on both the instances and display the device details.
iv) Use the instances to sort the records by calling the sort() method.
